name: Michael Auger
biography: is an experienced IT Security specialist with extensive experience in integrating and leveraging IT security tools. He has leveraged a wide range of IT security solutions, integrating them, to deliver leading edge incident response and security operations capabilities. His 15+ year career includes: · Supporting security incidents during the event and the subsequent remediation phases · Implementing and managing IT security infrastructures for public and private organizations. · Design and implement global SIEM infrastructure for F100 organizations · Delivering training on advanced SIEM solutions and network discovery tools · Presenting and publishing security articles on security vulnerabilities and best practices
